title: Egebis Seyir Presenter Guide
subtitle: Presenting Seyir in 5 minutes: what to show and what to say.

sections.title: Quick tour: Seyir in 5 minutes (for presenting)

blocks.text: This section is for learning the app quickly and showing it to others. The long explanations are in the later sections; here you only get **what to show and what to say**.

items: **What is Seyir?** An app where a team plans all its work in one place, moves it forward in sprints and tracks it.
**Who is it for?** Everyone who writes work, does work or follows progress: managers, product owners, developers, stakeholders.
**What is different?** It runs on your own server, so data stays in the company. Turkish and English.

head: Show on screen
What to say
rows: **Create Project** in the left menu (purple button)
Every product or team gets its own workspace.
The purple **New** button at the top
One door for adding work: Sprint, Task, Epic and Bug all start here.
Add an **Epic** and some **Tasks** under it
A big goal is an Epic, a piece of work is a Task, small parts are Sub-Tasks.
**Drag** a Task onto another Task
Dragging is enough: confirm and it becomes a Sub-Task; drop it on “Detach” to make it a Task again.
New → **Sprint**
A sprint is the team’s 1–2 week goal; its dates and goal are written here.
**Move work** from the Backlog into the Sprint
The team chooses which work it will do this period.
**Sprint board**: drag a card between columns
Everyone sees at a glance which stage each piece of work is in.
Red **Bugs** tab (next to Reports) → report a Bug → assign → Resolved
Bugs do not get lost: each has an owner, an assignee and a status, and everyone is emailed.
**Reports**: Burndown and Velocity
Will the sprint finish on time, how much does the team deliver: it is in the chart.
**Share** on an Epic; Settings → **Roles**
Who sees and changes what can be set from the whole Project down to a single item.

blocks.text: Before the presentation, prepare a Project, a few Tasks and a Sprint. Typing from scratch takes time; with ready data you finish in 5 minutes. Dragging and Bugs are the crowd-pleasers, so give them time.

blocks.alt: Seyir home screen with marked areas
blocks.caption: Main screen: use the left menu for the Project and its sections, and the top bar for search, help and your account.
legend: **Project**: The project area you work in. Click to open the sections below it.
**Backlog and sprints**: Sprints are created and planned here.
**Sprint board**: Shows the sprint's work in status columns (Kanban).
**Tasks**: The Project's work list; Tasks and Sub-Tasks are added here.
**Search**: Find a task, document or person (shortcut: Ctrl + K).
**Help**: Open this guide at any time.
**Account menu**: Profile, language, theme and sign out.
**New item row**: Type a title and press Enter to add a task.

items: **Where is the data?** On the company’s own server (PostgreSQL). A daily backup is taken automatically; a Project can also be restored from a backup.
**Who sees what?** Roles and permissions are edited in Settings → Roles; a single Epic or Task can be made “Private” and opened only to chosen people.
**Can files be attached?** Yes, any file type up to 100 MB on Tasks and Epics.
**Are there notifications?** Yes: in the app and by email (assignment, comment, status, Bug). The email setup is entered in Settings → General.
**How is it different from other tools?** Scrum (Sprints, Backlog, Burndown) and Kanban together; Turkish; on your own server.
